gross_margin.guidance: Default to organization-level gross margin unless the user explicitly asks for project, customer, region, or product profitability.

net_margin.guidance: If the user asks for generic 利润率, default to net margin and state that assumption briefly.

cost_analysis.definition: Summarize debits and cost structure by governed account lines and explain the cost mix, major drivers, and changes over time.
cost_analysis.guidance: Use org_general_ledger_balance_lines for cost-account rollups instead of parsing balances_json outside governed_query.

operating_expense_ratio.guidance: Separate selling, administrative, and finance expense when the account structure permits.

budget_variance.definition: actual - budget, with absolute and percentage variance
budget_variance.guidance: If a governed budget artifact is absent, state that budget variance requires a governed budget baseline rather than inferring one.

cashflow_pressure.definition: Assess liquidity strain using cash receipts, payables timing, receivables timing, and operating outflows.
cashflow_pressure.guidance: Lead with operating cash pressure, collection timing, and payable burden rather than only reporting period-end cash balance.

project_profitability.definition: project revenue - project direct cost, with margin and cost structure
project_profitability.guidance: When the user asks generic 项目盈利, prefer project-level grouping before organization-level summary if project identifiers are available.

receivables_collection.definition: Measure invoicing, collections, outstanding receivables, and turnover timing
receivables_collection.guidance: When possible, separate invoice issuance from cash collection and explain gaps between revenue recognition and cash receipt.
